rule: Support: line through the 2 latest swing lows that no candle cuts (3 days each side), rising only. Resistance: the same through the 2 latest swing highs (any slope). Alert when price comes within 1% of a line after 5 closes more than 1% away (the 3rd touch). Watch only: the support touch was tested 2016-26, no better than the 50-day average.
